plain.li: Two carts through yesterday, salt and cloth, heading north.
The carters say the ford downriver is running high.
A pedlar came through with news three weeks old and sold it as new.
[quiet] Nothing on the road but weather, the carters say.
[quiet] A quiet road this week, which suits us.
[quiet] The carters had no news, and were glad of it.
[ws:war] The carters give the war camps a wide berth, and say {SITUATION} is not over.
[ws:war] Every cart through has a story of {SITUATION}, and none of them good.
[ws:sickness] The carters won't stop in the towns with {SITUATION} in them.
[ws:sickness] Word on the road is that {SITUATION} has reached the coast towns.
[ws:hunger] Grain is dear down the road, the carters say, with {SITUATION} on.
[ws:hunger] The carters came through half empty, which {SITUATION} explains.
[ws:trade] The carters say {SITUATION} has every trader on the road at once.
[ws:faith] The carters say the road is full of pilgrims because of {SITUATION}.
[ws:levy] Men marched past the post two days ago, raised for {SITUATION}.
[ws:road] The carters say {SITUATION} has made the road busier than any of us remember.
[ws:town] The carters say the new steading is the talk of the road, with {SITUATION}.
[ws:court] Every cart has an opinion on {SITUATION}, and none of them agree.
[ws:rush] Half the carts are heading for the diggings, the carters say, with {SITUATION} on.
[ws:herds] The carters saw the herds moving two days south, with {SITUATION}.
[ws:fair] The carters are all bound for {SITUATION}, and say the colony should send someone.
[ws:drought] The carters say the wells are low all down the road, with {SITUATION}.
[ws:weather] The carters say {SITUATION} has closed the high road for now.
[ws:fire] The carters came through smelling of smoke, and talking of {SITUATION}.
[ws:beast] The carters travel in pairs now, because of {SITUATION}.
[ws:sellswords] The carters say the sellswords of {SITUATION} are camped a day down the road.
[ws:peace] The carters say the road is safer since {SITUATION}.

warm.li: The carters asked after the colony, and I told them you were well.
[quiet] A quiet road, and the carters in good spirits, which is the best news there is.

cheerful.li: Three carts through and every one of them had a joke for us.
[ws:fair] The carters say {SITUATION} is worth the walk, and I believe them.

blunt.li: Carts came, carts went, nothing to tell.
[ws:war] Soldiers on the road, so keep your gate shut at night.

cold.li: The carters talk too much, but they said the road was clear.
[ws:sickness] The carters say {SITUATION} is spreading, so I'd keep strangers at the gate.
